config.label: Path to kubeconfig file; defaults to ~/
config.description: Path to kubeconfig file; defaults to ~/.kube/config if unset.

config.label: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'
config.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'. The published package metadata still targets stdio by default.

config.label: Server mode: 'all' (default), 'code', or 'tools'
config.description: Server mode: 'all' (default), 'code', or 'tools'. Controls which features are enabled.

config.label: Kubernetes context name to use
config.description: Kubernetes context name to use. If unset, uses the current context from kubeconfig.

config.label: Skip TLS certificate verification for Kubernetes API (use 'true' or '1')
config.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Kubernetes API (use 'true' or '1'). Not recommended for production.

config.label: Enable global sensitive data masking
config.description: Enable global sensitive data masking. Set to 'true' or '1' to mask sensitive values in responses.

config.label: Default timeout in milliseconds for operations
config.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for operations. If unset, uses plugin-specific defaults.

config.label: HTTP bind host when MCP_TRANSPORT=http
config.description: HTTP bind host when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

config.label: HTTP port when MCP_TRANSPORT=http
config.description: HTTP port when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.

config.label: HTTP endpoint path when MCP_TRANSPORT=http
config.description: HTTP endpoint path when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to /mcp.

config.label: Disable session IDs in HTTP mode
config.description: Disable session IDs in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' for stateless request handling.

config.label: Prefer JSON responses over SSE in HTTP mode
config.description: Prefer JSON responses over SSE in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' to enable.

config.label: Comma-separated Host allowlist for HTTP mode
config.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist for HTTP mode. Required when binding to 0.0.0.0 or ::.

config.label: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for HTTP mode
config.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for HTTP mode.

config.label: Disable Kubernetes plugin
config.description: Disable Kubernetes plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

config.label: Disable Helm plugin
config.description: Disable Helm plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

config.label: Disable Argo Workflows plugin
config.description: Disable Argo Workflows plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

config.label: Disable Argo CD plugin
config.description: Disable Argo CD plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.
